title: Lesson 15: Monolith vs Microservices — js-tools
desc: The cost of splitting a service, measured in numbers: same four-step use case, same amount of work per step, a monolith gives p99 2.06 ms and 18,887 req/s while microservices give 8.25 ms and 3,744 req/s — 4 times slower at the tail, 5 times less throughput. Cumulative availability measured matches the formula to within 0.1 percentage points (92.18% for 8 hops). And a saga missing a compensating action left 200 orders charged but never fulfilled, with not a single error logged.
